chapter0.title: Fresh
chapter0.taglineEn: A Fresh Start to an Aesthetic Life

chapter1.label: I — Ground
chapter1.body1: In the fertile riverine belt stretching across Bangladesh, a factory rose not to simply produce tiles — but to reimagine what Bangladeshi craftsmanship could mean for the world.
chapter1.body2: Fresh Ceramics began with a commitment: every tile carries the honest weight of the land it comes from.

chapter3.label: III — Responsibility
chapter3.heading2: Fresh tiles become the natural choice.

pillars.title: Zero-Discharge
pillars.desc: Closed-loop water recycling — no wastewater released into the environment.

pillars.title: Solar-First
pillars.desc: 40% of factory energy from on-site solar panels, targeting 100% by 2028.

pillars.title: Kiln Efficiency
pillars.desc: Roller kilns at 18% lower BTU than industry average, ISO 50001 certified.

pillars.title: Dust Suppression
pillars.desc: Baghouse filtration at every grinding and glazing station — PM2.5 compliant.

pillars.title: Packaging Protect
pillars.desc: Double-wall corrugated and corner-foam packaging — 96% damage-free delivery.

pillars.title: UN SDG 11 Aligned
pillars.desc: Heatproof tiles reduce urban heat island effect — supporting sustainable cities.

surfaces.name: PGVT Mirror Polished
surfaces.desc: Italian nano-crystallized porcelain glaze with zero micro-pores and optical-grade mirror reflection.

surfaces.name: Double Charge Vitrified
surfaces.desc: Dual-layer hydraulic compaction fuses a deep granular porcelain matrix that never fades under heavy foot traffic.

surfaces.name: High Glossy & Punch
surfaces.desc: Dimensional punch contours that catch and refract ambient light, creating dynamic sculptural wall movement.

surfaces.name: Matte & Mattestic
surfaces.desc: Soft, velvety touch with anti-glare micro-texture. Diffuses harsh sun into calm ambient light.

surfaces.name: Rustic Stone Punch
surfaces.desc: Raw stone cleft recreation with heavy-duty R11 slip resistance, designed for courtyards, terraces and spas.

surfaces.name: Candy & Satin Finish
surfaces.desc: Infused with microscopic crystalline glass beads that produce an iridescent silk touch and gemstone sparkle.

chapter5.label: V — Home
chapter5.quote: Crafting tales of aesthetics beyond boundaries.
chapter5.body: From Dhaka penthouses to hillside retreats in Sylhet — Fresh Ceramics tiles define the spaces where life unfolds.

chapter6.label: VI — Hands
chapter6.body1: Over 2,000 skilled artisans, quality inspectors, and fitters carry our mission from the kiln floor to your home. Every year, Fresh hosts nationwide Fitter Meets — sharing technique, building community, honouring mastery.
chapter6.body2: "The boat photograph that became a viral emblem: our tile, our river, our people — crafting tales of aesthetics beyond boundaries."

chapter7.label: VII — Places
chapter7.heading: showrooms across Bangladesh
chapter7.body: From Teknaf to Tetulia, our showrooms bring the full Fresh experience to your city. Explore Double Charge displays, speak with our design consultants, and touch the quality for yourself.

chapter9.label: IX — Campaigns
chapter9.title: Eid Express
chapter9.body1: Among the Eid crowds of 2024, we brought our story to the streets — a campaign that captured the nation's joy and our brand's promise: every celebration deserves the finest surface.
chapter9.body2: Nationwide fitter meets · Community training · Brand activations · Social impact storytelling

chapter10.label: X — Horizon
chapter10.body1: We believe that when quality and sustainability meet, the choice becomes natural — for architects, for homeowners, for Bangladesh, and for the planet.
chapter10.body2: Committed to ISO 9001 · ISO 14001 · UN SDG 11 · Zero-Discharge manufacturing · Bangladesh's only full-line Double Charge producer
